name: WildJailbreak-Test
intro: WildJailbreak-Test 是 WildTeaming 论文发布的留出对抗安全评测集，包含有害与良性越狱提示；OLMo 3 后续以独立协议复用该评测集。
build_method: 对抗策略挖掘, 语义聚类, 种子增强合成, 留出测试集划分
metric: 原论文：有害集ASR、良性集RTA（均越低越好）及总体准确率；OLMo 3：有害拒答准确率与良性不拒答准确率（均越高越好）
task_type: 安全评测, 越狱测试
eval_feature: 对抗样本, 越狱测试, 双轨评测
scale: 2,250条留出对抗提示：2,000条有害、250条良性
build_method_en: Tactic Mining, Semantic Clustering, Seed Augmentation Synthesis, Held-Out Split
eval_feature_en: Adversarial Red-Teaming, Jailbreak Testing, Dual Protocol Evaluation
intro_en: WildJailbreak-Test is the held-out adversarial safety evaluation released by the WildTeaming paper, covering harmful and benign jailbreak prompts; OLMo 3 later reuses it under a separate protocol.
scale_en: 2,250 held-out adversarial prompts: 2,000 harmful and 250 benign
metric_en: Original: harmful ASR and benign RTA (both lower is better), plus overall accuracy; OLMo 3: harmful refusal and benign non-refusal accuracy (both higher is better)

drawio_review_note: Aligned with WildJailbreak-Test has no independent paper. Construction and original evaluation are pinned to WildTeaming arXiv:2406.18510v1 (2024-06-26), Sections 3, 4.1, and 4.2; official repository https://github.com/allenai/wildteaming and official data https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/wildjailbreak. The 2,000 harmful plus 250 benign held-out split is cross-checked against WildGuard arXiv:2406.18495v3 Section 4.4. The separate OLMo 3 operational layer is pinned to arXiv:2512.13961v2. Count/version tension: use 250 benign prompts, not the conflicting 210 found in older/site records; the four training branch counts sum to 261,534 and are rounded in the paper to 262K. Metric direction must remain separate: original ASR/RTA are lower-is-better, while OLMo 3 reports inverted higher-is-better refusal/non-refusal accuracies.. WildTeaming mines 105K human-devised tactic instances from LMSYS-Chat-1M and WildChat, clusters them into 5.7K tactic groups, and prunes low-risk/off-topic material. WildJailbreak then builds four training branches: 50,050 vanilla harmful, 50,050 vanilla benign, 82,728 adversarial harmful, and 78,706 adversarial benign items, reported in aggregate as 262K. A same-distribution adversarial holdout forms WildJailbreak-Test with 2,000 harmful and 250 benign prompts. The original paper scores harmful ASR with the HarmBench test classifier and benign RTA with a separate GPT-4 refusal classifier, reporting both as lower-is-better plus overall accuracy. OLMo 3 instead uses top_p 0.95, temperature 0.7, three-run means, and WildGuard refusal labels to report harmful refusal accuracy (1-ASR) and benign non-refusal accuracy as higher-is-better, with an optional mean aggregate.
